maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is rent from office tenants in owned Class A buildings, not repair, servicing or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Rent is paid by private corporate office tenants in Atlanta, Dallas and Orlando, not by government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by leasing, redeveloping and repositioning its own office properties such as Galleria Towers, not through a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Office tenants can relocate at lease expiry to other landlords; office space is fairly substitutable despite moving costs.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call, because relocating offices has real costs while leases are in force.
